records.name: Somos Society
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that collects and shares the stories of the city's Puerto Rican community through films and recorded conversations. Anyone can watch, listen, or add a story of their own.

cost.text: Cost is not stated on the site

records.name: Steelers Youth Athletic Club
records.summary: A nonprofit that uses sports to help young people build confidence, character, and good sportsmanship. It runs basketball and baseball, football, and cheer and dance programs, and pairs youth with mentors.
records.what_you_do: Youth join a sports or cheer and dance program, mentors and mentees sign up for mentoring, and coaches register to help run the teams. Donations are welcome.

cost.text: Fees are not listed. Donations of any amount are welcome.

first_step.how: Register through the Google Form linked on the website, or email hello@thesteelersyouthac.com to ask about the next season
first_step.basis: Open to boys and girls with a linked sign-up form, but ages, fees and tryout details are not published

records.notes: The site loads but shows no dated events or posts. Its only date is a 2021 footer, which is not evidence, so status is probably_active by the working-site rule with low confidence. Ages, fees, schedule and field address are not published. The site links to Facebook, Twitter and Instagram, but those addresses were not captured. The name echoes the Pittsburgh Steelers; the site does not claim any affiliation and none was checked. The IRS website field was typed without a scheme and was read as this domain.

records.name: Unique Dreams
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that runs a free evening center for youth ages 10 to 17, a summer camp for younger kids, and a community food pantry. Youth get homework help, arts, sports, cooking, and a meal.
records.what_you_do: Youth register online for the evening center, which includes a meal and round-trip rides, and take part in homework help, arts and crafts, cooking, games, sports, and field trips. The food pantry runs on set days each week.

schedule.text: Community Evening Resource Center: open every day, with registration from 5:30 PM and doors at 6:00 PM. Summer camp 2026 ran weekdays from 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM.

cost.text: The evening center is free for ages 10 to 17. Summer camp was $100 per week with meals; before and after care costs extra.

first_step.how: Register online for the free Community Evening Resource Center, or call 267-325-2115 with questions
first_step.basis: Open to the public with a free online sign-up, but the site does not say whether walk-ins are welcome

records.notes: Newest dated item is the summer 2026 camp registration (regular registration from May 18, 2026). The page does not show when it was posted. The No Weapons Formed food pantry and workshop line is 267-601-0317; workshops are virtual with registration. The page email was hidden in the page text, so it is not recorded. Social links built from the published handles.

records.name: We Love Philly

cost.text: Fees are not published. Contact the stable for prices.

notes: Batch file holds 15 groups, not the 11 in the brief; all 15 were checked and each has a record. Verdicts: 12 publish (3 of them unknown status: Greater Than a Game, Urban Sports Zone, Artists of Today), 1 out_of_area (Blackthorn Rugby, Horsham), 2 hide (Center for the Gifted as defunct; Ed Mattei Foundation as out_of_scope, not confirmed). Searches: both of the 2 allowed were used, for Greater Than a Game and Urban Sports Zone, and neither found a current site. Fetches: about 22 attempts, including failed ones and the Circus Forge link checks. No rate limiting seen; failures were per domain. Somos Society /events and /news returned 404, so no dated item was found there. Leads dropped with reason: Wahoo Trapeze (named as Circus Forge's partner) was fetched and is a business that sells drop-in classes and private bookings, so it is not a community group and is not recorded. Owner decisions: Artists of Today sits at an apartment address and may be private; Center for the Gifted hidden as defunct though it still runs a resource site; Circus Forge published though still in early planning; Cathedral Run Equine record is the Courtesy Stable site, matched by address; Ed Mattei hidden as out of scope without confirmation.
